card.name: King Vegeta, the Majestic Ruler
card.skill: [Permanent] Negate the skills of all other Battle Cards.

qa.q: When this card is in play, can it negate skills of your opponent's Battle Cards that have [Barrier]?
qa.a: Yes, it can.

qa.q: If there is a {DB04-66 King Vegeta, the Majestic Ruler} in play in your opponent's Battle Area and you play this card, can you negate the skill of your opponent's {DB04-66 King Vegeta, the Majestic Ruler}?
qa.a:
No, you can't.
The continuous effect of your opponent's {DB04-66 King Vegeta, the Majestic Ruler} negates this card’s skill.

qa.q: If you have this card in play in your Battle Area and you use {P-069 Miracle Strike Gogeta} to negate the skill of your opponent's {DB04-66 King Vegeta, the Majestic Ruler}, does your opponent's {DB04-66 King Vegeta, the Majestic Ruler} get its skill back during the end phase?
qa.a:
No, it doesn't.
After you negate the skill of your opponent's {DB04-66 King Vegeta, the Majestic Ruler}, this card's skill remains active; once {P-069 Miracle Strike Gogeta}'s effect wears off, the skill of your opponent's {DB04-66 King Vegeta, the Majestic Ruler} remains negated.

qa.q: If you have this card in play, do any Battle Cards played with [Over Realm] get sent to their owners' Warps at end of turn?
qa.a:
Yes, they do.
The skills of all other Battle Cards are negated, but since [Over Realm] is activated and resolved in advance, any cards played with [Over Realm] are sent to their owners' Warps at end of turn.

qa.q: {BT1-043 Whis, Judge of the Gods} is played when this card is already in play. Are {BT1-043 Whis, Judge of the Gods}’s skills negated?
qa.a: No, they aren’t.

qa.q: If you have this card in play and there are Shadow Tokens being given [Blocker] by {BT7-046 Mass Replication}'s permanent skill, are the skills on those Shadow Tokens negated?
qa.a: Yes, they are.

qa.q: You have this card in play, and activate {TB3-048 Preemptive Strike} in response to your opponent playing a Battle Card with an energy cost of 4 or less. If the Battle Card being played has [Deflect], is that Battle Card affected by the [Counter : Play] of {TB3-048 Preemptive Strike}?
qa.a: No, it isn't.

qa.q: You have this card in play and activate {DB04-020 Galick Cannon} in response to your opponent playing a Battle Card. If the Battle Card being played has [Deflect], is that Battle Card affected by the [Counter : Play] of {DB04-020 Galick Cannon}?
qa.a:
Yes, it is.
{DB04-020 Galick Cannon}'s [Counter : Play] skill is applied to Battle Cards that are played in a Battle Area, and once the card is played its [Deflect] is negated by this card's permanent skill.

qa.q: If you have this card and {BT6-047 Babidi, Overseer of Destruction} in play in your Battle Area, can you use {BT3-029 Baby's Subdual} to gain control of your opponent's {BT6-047 Babidi, Overseer of Destruction}?
qa.a:
Yes, you can.
The permanent skills of both players’ {BT6-047 Babidi, Overseer of Destruction} cards are negated, so you can gain control of your opponent’s copy.

qa.q: Does DB1-066 King Vegeta, the Majestic Ruler negate skills on Battle Cards in your hand, drop area, etc.?
qa.a: No, it only negates the skills on Battle Cards in the Battle Area.

qa.q: How come I can use the effect of {BT1-043 Whis, Judge of the Gods} and {TB1-097 Son Goku, The Awakened Power} when my opponent has {DB1-066 King Vegeta, the Majestic Ruler} in play? How is this different from {BT1-107 Cold Bloodlust} negating their skills?
qa.a:
The [Permanent] skill of {Whis, Judge of the Gods} and {Son Goku, The Awakened Power} is only applied when in your Battle Area. This is the same as how the {BT7-119 Champa and Vados, Gracious Aid} effect that reduces combo cost is not applied unless the card is played in your Battle Area.
Because {Cold Bloodlust} negates the skills of your opponent’s Battle Card in hand before it is played, the [Permanent] skill of {Whis, Judge of the Gods} and {Son Goku, The Awakened Power} are not activated when they are played in the Battle Area. Therefore, {Cold Bloodlust} negates the skills of {Whis, Judge of the Gods} and {Son Goku, The Awakened Power}.

qa.q: How come if {DB1-066 King Vegeta, the Majestic Ruler} is already in play, {BT1-043 Whis, Judge of the Gods} and {TB1-097 Son Goku, The Awakened Power} can activate their [Permanent] skill?
qa.a:
Cards like {Whis, Judge of the Gods} and {Son Goku, The Awakened Power} have [Permanent] skills that apply as soon as they move from your hand to your Battle Area. {King Vegeta, the Majestic Ruler}’s skill works in the same way.
Therefore, {Whis, Judge of the Gods} and {Son Goku, The Awakened Power}’s skills can’t be negated at that point. If you wanted to negate skills like these, you have to negate them before the cards are played.
Reference:
Official Rules: 0-2-5: If a card effect directs a player to carry out a certain action, yet there is an active effect prohibiting that action, that effect is prioritized and the action is not conducted.

qa.q: Why can’t you use the effects of a second {DB1-066 King Vegeta, the Majestic Ruler} when another {King Vegeta, the Majestic Ruler} is in play?
qa.a:
{King Vegeta, the Majestic Ruler} doesn’t have an effect that prevents his skills from being negated, so {King Vegeta, the Majestic Ruler} is different from {BT1-043 Whis, Judge of the Gods} in that 1-3-3 from the General Rules doesn’t apply to him. As such, the skills of the {King Vegeta, the Majestic Ruler} played first are given priority.
Reference:
Official Rules: 0-2-5: If a card effect directs a player to carry out a certain action, yet there is an active effect prohibiting that action, that effect is prioritized and the action is not conducted.

card.name: SS3 Gotenks, Blazing Fusion
card.skill:
[Ultimate][Double Strike]
[Permanent] Reduce the energy cost of this card by 1 for each Battle Card with 15000 power in your Drop Area.
[Permanent] Negate the skills of all other Battle Cards.
[Auto] When this card is removed from your Battle Area by an opponent's skill, choose all of your opponent's Battle Cards and energy in Rest Mode, ignoring [Barrier], and place them in their owners' Drop Areas.

qa.q: When you have this card in play, are the skills of your opponent's Battle Cards with [Barrier] negated?
qa.a: Yes, they are.

qa.q: If your opponent has {DB1-066 King Vegeta, the Majestic Ruler} in play in their Battle Area and you play this card, are your opponent's skills negated?
qa.a: No, they aren't. The permanent skill of your opponent's {DB1-066 King Vegeta, the Majestic Ruler} takes effect, negating the skills on your cards (including this one).

qa.q: If you have this card in play in your Battle Area and you use {P-069 Miracle Strike Gogeta}'s skill to negate your opponent's {DB1-066 King Vegeta, the Majestic Ruler}'s skill, will the skill of your opponent's {DB1-066 King Vegeta, the Majestic Ruler} come back into effect during the End Phase?
qa.a: No, it won't. Once your opponent's {DB1-066 King Vegeta, the Majestic Ruler}'s skill is negated, this card's skill comes into effect. Even when {P-069 Miracle Strike Gogeta}'s skill wears off, {DB1-066 King Vegeta, the Majestic Ruler}'s skill will remain negated.

qa.q: When this card is in play, will Battle Cards played using [Over Realm] still be sent to their owners’ Warps at the end of the turn?
qa.a: Yes, they will. The Battle Card's skills will be negated, but [Over Realm] was activated and resolved, so the cards are still sent to their owners’ Warps.

qa.q: When this card is in play and {BT1-043 Whis, Judge of the Gods} is played, are {BT1-043 Whis, Judge of the Gods}'s skills negated?
qa.a: No, they aren’t.

qa.q: When this card is in play and there are Shadow Tokens in play with [Blocker] that were created by the permanent skill of {BT7-046 Mass Replication}, are the skills of those Shadow Tokens negated?
qa.a: Yes, they are.

qa.q: This card is in play and your opponent activates {TB3-048 Preemptive Strike} in response to a Battle Card with an energy cost of 4 or less being played. If the Battle Card being played has [Deflect], is that card affected by {TB3-048 Preemptive Strike}'s [Counter : Play] skill?
qa.a: No, it isn't. {TB3-048 Preemptive Strike} is used during Counter Window 1, before the Battle Card is played, so the Battle Card still has [Deflect].

qa.q: This card is in play and your opponent activates {DB1-020 Galick Cannon} in response to a Battle Card being played. If the Battle Card being played has [Deflect], is that card affected by {DB1-020 Galick Cannon}'s [Counter : Play] skill?
qa.a: Yes, it is. {DB1-020 Galick Cannon} is used during Counter Window 2, so the Battle Card is already played. This card's permanent skill negates the Battle Card's [Deflect], and the Battle Card is affected by {DB1-020 Galick Cannon}'s [Counter : Play] skill.

qa.q: If you have this card and {BT6-047 Babidi, Overseer of Destruction} in play, can you gain control of another copy of {BT6-047 Babidi, Overseer of Destruction} using {BT3-029 Baby's Subdual}?
qa.a: Yes, you can. The [Permanent] skill on both players' copies of {BT6-047 Babidi, Overseer of Destruction} is negated, so you can have more than one copy in play.

qa.q: If your opponent uses a skill to gain control of this card, can they activate and resolve this card’s auto skill?
qa.a: Yes, it activates. The master of the Battle Area prior to the card changing control becomes the master of this skill, and activates and resolves it.

qa.q: Can you add this card to your hand using {BT3-105 Planet Vegeta}’s auto skill?
qa.a: No, you can’t.
